upload.itMessage:
Hello IT team,

For the Sanford ERP migration of {{company}} ({{name}}), please run the attached 05_hana_export.sql on the HANA schema {{schema}}:

1. Query 1 → save as columns.csv (column order; the data files have no header)
2. Query 2 → save as constraints.csv (real table keys)
3. Query 4 → save as row_counts.csv (rows per table)
4. Query 9 (EXPORT "{{schema}}"."*" AS CSV) → the data export folder

Please use CSV, not Excel (Excel changes some table names, e.g. AUG1 becomes a date). Zip the export folder together with the three CSV files and upload it in Super ERP › Back Office › Upload backup, or send me the link.

Thank you

count.title: Inventory Counting
count.desc: Count a warehouse on a phone, review the variance report, and post the difference. Big variances need approval.
count.newSub: Every item with stock in the warehouse (per bin where bins are used) goes on the sheet.
count.blindNote: Blind count: the system quantity is hidden until the count is submitted.
count.submitWhat: Within the rules it posts at once. A line more than the % limit off, or a total above the value limit, waits for approval.

lots.desc: Super ERP batches and serial numbers with their stock per warehouse, and the SAP copy (no quantities).

setup.title: Inventory Setup
setup.desc: Bins per warehouse, warehouse stock accounts, goods receipt and issue reasons, and blind counting. Every change is logged.
setup.financeOnly: Only Financials with full access can change stock accounts.
setup.reasonsFinance: Only Financials with full access can change reasons, because they decide the account.
